title: The Self Driving Portfolio: Agentic Architecture for Institutional Asset Management
abstract: arXiv:2604.02279v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Agentic AI shifts the investor's role from analytical execution to oversight. We present an agentic strategic asset allocation pipeline in which 44 specialized agents produce capital market assumptions, construct portfolios using 21 competing methods, and critique and vote on each other's outputs. A researcher agent proposes new portfolio construction methods not yet represented, and a meta agent compares past forecasts against realized returns and rewrites agent code and prompts to improve future performance. The entire pipeline is governed by the Investment Policy Statement - the same document that guides human portfolio managers can now constrain and direct autonomous agents.

translated_title: 自动驾驶投资组合：面向机构资产管理的智能体架构
translated_abstract: 智能体AI将投资者的角色从分析执行转变为监督。我们提出了一个智能体化的战略资产配置流水线，其中44个专业化智能体负责生成资本市场假设，使用21种相互竞争的方法构建投资组合，并对彼此的输出进行批评和投票。一个研究员智能体会提出尚未被现有方法涵盖的新型投资组合构建方法，而一个元智能体则将过去的预测与实际收益进行对比，并重写智能体的代码和提示词以提升未来表现。整个流水线由投资政策声明治理——过去用于指导人类投资组合经理的同一份文件，如今也可以约束和引导自主运行的智能体。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个由44个专业智能体组成的战略资产配置系统，智能体通过21种竞争性方法构建投资组合并相互批评投票，元智能体通过对比预测与实际收益实现自我改进，整个系统由投资政策声明治理，将投资者角色从执行转变为监督。
en_tdlr: The paper presents an agentic strategic asset allocation pipeline in which 44 specialized agents generate capital market assumptions, construct portfolios using 21 competing methods with peer critique and voting, and a meta agent self-improves the system by comparing forecasts against realized returns—all governed by the Investment Policy Statement.
